## We use technology to protect platform integrity, but we don't fact-check reviews

While we don't verify specific claims because reviewers' opinions are their own, we may label reviews as "Verified" when we can confirm a business interaction took place. Read more

To protect platform integrity, every review on our platform—verified or not—is screened by our 24/7 automated software. This technology is designed to identify and remove content that breaches our guidelines, including reviews that are not based on a genuine experience. We recognise we may not catch everything, and you can flag anything you think we may have missed. Read more

## Review summary

Based on reviews, created with AI

Most reviewers were somewhat happy with their experience overall. Many customers appreciate the personalized products, often highlighting the beautiful prints, colors, and wide selection available. People frequently praise the quality of the materials, noting that items like t-shirts and sweatshirts are soft, well-made, and hold up well after washing. The customer service is consistently described as responsive, helpful, and outstanding, with many reviewers commending the quick responses and willingness to correct order issues. However, some people were dissatisfied with aspects of the product and order fulfillment. Several customers reported issues with delivery, including delayed shipments, items not being received by the postal service despite tracking numbers being created, and missed delivery dates. There were also concerns about product quality, with some reviewers stating that the received items did not match the website's depictions, citing low-quality materials, poor printing, and misleading representations of products like ornaments.See more
